title: Technical Co-Lead · CSI-CATT
description: Elected Technical Co-Lead of CSI-CATT DMCE for 2026-27. Not a title handed out - voted in by the chapter. Now running the technical side of the college's Computer Society: workshops, hackathons, dev projects. Started as a contributor. Ended up leading the room.

title: Shipped to 500+ Users · SIMS
description: Most portfolio projects live on localhost. SIMS lives at a college domain with 500 students who have accounts - and unlike most software people sign up for, they actually log in. Built during my internship under the HOD - I owned the entire frontend. Shipping to real users hits different.

title: Internship · Full Dev Team
description: The full development team behind the Student Information Management System. A real-world deployment serving an entire college - built from scratch during a structured internship program under direct mentorship of the Head of Department.

title: Internship Certificate · DMCE
description: Official internship completion certificate from Datta Meghe College of Engineering. Formal recognition of the full-stack development work and contribution to the SIMS platform deployed across the institution.

title: Letter of Appreciation
description: Received an official Letter of Appreciation for outstanding contribution during the internship. A formal acknowledgment from the institution for the quality and impact of the development work delivered.

title: Official Certificate · TT Doubles
description: The official certificate for securing 2nd place in the DMCE Milestone 2025 Table Tennis Doubles. A reminder that agility and strategy apply just as much on the table as they do in code.

title: Top 8 Finalist · Code-A-Thon 2.0
description: Out of 100+ submissions, Singularity placed Top 8. Built over 1.5 months - not a weekend sprint - it pulled real-time telemetry from NASA, SpaceX, and ISRO into a single mission control. Orbital mechanics, 3D globe rendering, AI integration, live ISS tracking.

title: The Team Behind Singularity
description: Code-A-Thon 2.0 wasn't a solo mission. The team that built Singularity - each member owning a critical subsystem. From backend architecture to 3D rendering, the project came together through late nights and relentless iteration.

title: 2nd Place · Table Tennis Doubles
description: Partnered with a senior and competed in the DMCE Milestone 2025 Table Tennis Doubles tournament. Fought our way to the finals and secured 2nd place - as a first-year in Sem 2. Proof that competitive drive isn't limited to a keyboard.
